name: methods
value: Survival was estimated using the Kaplan-Meier method. Cumulative incidence is reported as 1 minus the Kaplan-Meier survival estimate, which is valid only in the absence of competing risks; with competing events a competing-risks estimator (Aalen-Johansen) should be used instead. Groups were compared using the log-rank test. Analysis performed in Stata 17 (StataCorp, College Station, TX).
